description.en: Read when using Cybion: the built-in operating guide (ships with the source, shared by every user, read-only) — Ultimate Machines, Linkit notifications, loaded Manuals, and the two standing user Manuals (project index, value bias) with their formats. One manual, no child nodes.
description.zh: 使用 Cybion 时需要查看：自带的操作指南（随源码发布、所有用户共享、只读）——终极机器、Linkit 通知、加载手册，以及两份常备用户手册（项目索引、价值偏置）与它们的格式。只有这一份，不分设子节点。
